solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

S071-01.notes: Initially doubted, later confirmed in other organisms and awarded a Nobel -> 'vindicated'. A superseded: work was confirmed, not replaced. C disregarded: contradicts the later acceptance and Nobel. D anticipated: the 1970s findings confirmed rather than were foreseen by her work in this sentence's logic; the colon's Nobel evidence points to vindication, not foreshadowing.

S071-02.notes: Nesting sites track magnetic drift, and each coastline has a magnetic signature, so turtles likely use those signatures (hedged 'may'/'partly'). A overstates ('alone', 'ignore every other cue'). B: the nesting sites shifted, not the beaches themselves; and it is restatement, not inference. C reverses causation.

S071-03.notes: Computed: Westside 600->1,200 = +100%; Eastside 1,200->1,500 = +25%; Eastside 1,500 > 1,200 in 2023. A gives the rate contrast (doubled vs. 25% rise) and Eastside's continued lead, addressing both parts of the claim. B gives absolute gains (600 vs 300), which is not a rate and omits the 2023 comparison. C covers only the 2023 totals. D covers only 2019.

S071-04.notes: Monte Verde at ~14,500 years predates Clovis (~13,000), challenging Clovis-first. A contradicts the dating. B: no claim about Clovis point ages. D: no Clovis points mentioned at Monte Verde.

S071-05.notes: Discovery (hand washing reduces deaths) and results, rejection by physicians, later acceptance after germ theory. A: no two competing theories presented. C: hand washing was adopted, not abandoned. D: no claim about midwives' training.

S071-06.notes: Introductory modifier 'Built and expanded over many years' must attach to the nests. C 'some of these nests' correct. A attaches it to the birds (dangling). B attaches it to 'close to a ton'. D attaches it to 'the weight'.

S071-07.notes: 'however' is a parenthetical interrupter between subject and verb, so it needs a comma on both sides: 'Pteropus, however, do not echolocate'. B lacks the closing comma. C semicolon and D colon would split subject from verb, leaving incomplete clauses.

S071-08.notes: Harsh, caustic lake vs. key flamingo breeding site is a concession/contrast -> 'Even so'. A restatement, B example, and C similarity don't fit the contrast.

S071-09.notes: B states both the evidence (late eclipses when Earth was farther) and the conclusion. A gives only background, no conclusion. C gives the conclusion and prior belief but no supporting evidence. D gives only the prior belief.

S071-10.notes: Subject is singular 'Each' (of the system's symbols), and the narration is a general present fact: 'stands for'. B, C, D are plural forms ('stand', 'are', 'have').

S071-11.notes: D contrasts gelatin's flaws (melts, broken down) with agar's advantages (stays solid, resists breakdown), which explains the improvement. A covers Hesse's kitchen origin, B covers only gelatin's use, C covers only agar's current use; none explains why agar is better.
